title: Valley Dealer Suite
description: Valley® is the world's leading irrigation brand. Yet dealer representatives had no mobile tool to manage complex order pipelines.

hero.headline: A centralized mobile hub for the Valley® dealer ecosystem.

paragraphs: Valley® is the world's leading irrigation brand. Yet dealer representatives — managing complex order pipelines daily — had no mobile tool to do this simply and efficiently.

The Valley® Dealer Suite is a centralized mobile hub — a single app where dealers can track open orders, receive real-time notifications, access the Valley® app ecosystem, and get clear status updates on every order in their pipeline, all from their phone.

phases.title: Discover
phases.description: Research on dealer workflows, pain points, and existing Valley® tools.

phases.title: Define
phases.description: Mapped user goals, core flows, and information architecture.

phases.title: Design
phases.description: Wireframes → Hi-Fi screens → Component system, Valley® brand aligned.

phases.title: Prototype
phases.description: Interactive Figma prototypes for stakeholder review and flow validation.

phases.title: Handoff
phases.description: Dev-ready Figma file with annotated specs and design tokens. 100% complete.

applications.heading: Every screen built for a dealer in the field.

apps.name: Authentication & Onboarding
apps.subtitle: The entry experience was designed to be fast, trusted, and brand-forward.

keyChanges.after: Brand-first entry with app version info and a single primary CTA.
Post-login landing communicates the three key app capabilities instantly.

apps.insight: The dark navy header with the white Valley® logo was maintained throughout the entire app — dealers always know exactly which platform they're on.

apps.name: Order Management
apps.subtitle: The heart of the app. Dealers need to know — at a glance — what orders are open, delayed, unconfirmed.

keyChanges.after: Card rows with order number, date, status badge, PO number, and total.
Filter by status, sort by date — quickly narrowing to orders that need attention.

apps.insight: The 'Last Checked' timestamp on the orders dashboard was a deliberate trust signal.

apps.name: Notification System & Launchpad
apps.subtitle: Notifications split into three color-coded categories.

keyChanges.after: Three color-coded notification categories preventing alert fatigue.
Valley® App Launchpad serves as a single entry point to the entire Valley® digital ecosystem.

outcome.quote: Enterprise tools deserve the same UX craft as consumer apps. Every second of confusion costs real trust — and real revenue.

deliverables.title: Unified Pipeline
deliverables.description: One app replaced multiple fragmented touchpoints.

deliverables.title: Zero Missed Alerts
deliverables.description: Three color-coded notification streams ensure order delays reach dealers through the right priority channel.

deliverables.title: Self-Service Day One
deliverables.description: A 6-step tooltip walkthrough eliminated the need for training sessions.

screens.heading: Every screen built for a dealer in the field.
screens.description: The complete iOS experience from login to order management.
